spans.text: (Sigh) I can't believe we were so worried about you. So you were hiding here and relaxing.

units.rawText: When Kurenoyume Shrine was first built, this Kimie asked the Professor to install signal jamming here, in order to distance this place from discord and unrest.

spans.text: When Kurenoyume Shrine was first built, this Kimie asked the Professor to install signal jamming here, in order to distance this place from discord and unrest.

units.rawText: After Nora-sama entered the shrine, you could not be tracked or communicated with, much like being "spirited away" in certain legends.
units.displayText: After Nora-sama entered the shrine, you could not be tracked or communicated with, much like being "spirited away" in certain legends.

spans.text: After Nora-sama entered the shrine, you could not be tracked or communicated with, much like being "spirited away" in certain legends.

units.displayText: Tomorrow.

units.rawText: Oi, oi, oi! Didn't you come to the shrine to pray to the gods? Ask them for inspiration or something.
units.displayText: Oi, oi, oi! Didn't you come to the shrine to pray to the gods? Ask them for inspiration or something.

spans.text: Oi, oi, oi! Didn't you come to the shrine to pray to the gods? Ask them for inspiration or something.

units.displayText: If that actually worked, I'd be writing right now instead of chatting with you.

spans.text: If that actually worked, I'd be writing right now instead of chatting with you.

units.rawText: During my early years, while I was traveling with Kaede-sama, we once happened across a remote mountain village.
units.displayText: During my early years, while I was traveling with Kaede-sama, we once happened across a remote mountain village.

spans.text: During my early years, while I was traveling with Kaede-sama, we once happened across a remote mountain village.

units.rawText: It was surrounded by mountains and little word from the outside reached it. Life in the village seemed to have been frozen for decades, even centuries, and there were many mikos there who venerated the kami.
units.displayText: It was surrounded by mountains and little word from the outside reached it. Life in the village seemed to have been frozen for decades, even centuries, and there were many mikos there who venerated the kami.

spans.text: It was surrounded by mountains and little word from the outside reached it. Life in the village seemed to have been frozen for decades, even centuries, and there were many mikos there who venerated the kami.

units.rawText: It was the middle of summer, and the rain fell thick and hard. The waters surged to the heavens, and the flood that came burst a hole in the village's dam.
units.displayText: It was the middle of summer, and the rain fell thick and hard. The waters surged to the heavens, and the flood that came burst a hole in the village's dam.

spans.text: It was the middle of summer, and the rain fell thick and hard. The waters surged to the heavens, and the flood that came burst a hole in the village's dam.

units.rawText: When it seemed that the dam would break, the village chief decided to have the village's mikos block up the breach with their bodies.
units.displayText: When it seemed that the dam would break, the village chief decided to have the village's mikos block up the breach with their bodies.

spans.text: When it seemed that the dam would break, the village chief decided to have the village's mikos block up the breach with their bodies.

units.displayText: Wait, that's the legend of the "sacrificial maidens"!

spans.text: Wait, that's the legend of the "sacrificial maidens"!

units.rawText: Mm... That's right.
units.displayText: Mm... That's right.

spans.text: Mm... That's right.

units.displayText: Kimie closes her eyes and recalls a distant conversation.

spans.text: Kimie closes her eyes and recalls a distant conversation.

units.rawText: The flood is upon us and the village is doomed to ruin. My lord, please abandon the idea of having the mikos hold back the waters and evacuate the villagers post haste.
units.displayText: The flood is upon us and the village is doomed to ruin. My lord, please abandon the idea of having the mikos hold back the waters and evacuate the villagers post haste.

spans.text: The flood is upon us and the village is doomed to ruin. My lord, please abandon the idea of having the mikos hold back the waters and evacuate the villagers post haste.

units.rawText: There is an elevated plateau in the valley. The villagers can seek high ground, and we can rebuild the village.
units.displayText: There is an elevated plateau in the valley. The villagers can seek high ground, and we can rebuild the village.

spans.text: There is an elevated plateau in the valley. The villagers can seek high ground, and we can rebuild the village.

units.rawText: Oh foreign miko, this is our home. Do you know how long we worked to reach today's prosperity?
units.displayText: Oh foreign miko, this is our home. Do you know how long we worked to reach today's prosperity?

spans.text: Oh foreign miko, this is our home. Do you know how long we worked to reach today's prosperity?

units.rawText: Generations have been born and lived here. If we leave this place, we will become homeless wanderers.
units.displayText: Generations have been born and lived here. If we leave this place, we will become homeless wanderers.

spans.text: Generations have been born and lived here. If we leave this place, we will become homeless wanderers.

units.rawText: If we have angered the kami, then we should placate them. If it is the kami's will that we die, then die we must.
units.displayText: If we have angered the kami, then we should placate them. If it is the kami's will that we die, then die we must.

spans.text: If we have angered the kami, then we should placate them. If it is the kami's will that we die, then die we must.

units.rawText: Man-made mikos like you are a blasphemy against the kami. Since you do not belong to the village, you have no right to speak about our choices!
units.displayText: Man-made mikos like you are a blasphemy against the kami. Since you do not belong to the village, you have no right to speak about our choices!

spans.text: Man-made mikos like you are a blasphemy against the kami. Since you do not belong to the village, you have no right to speak about our choices!

units.rawText: Seems the village chief was pretty stubborn.
units.displayText: Seems the village chief was pretty stubborn.

spans.text: Seems the village chief was pretty stubborn.

units.rawText: That's how it is with perspectives from long ago. These insular villages have never welcomed outsiders.
units.displayText: That's how it is with perspectives from long ago. These insular villages have never welcomed outsiders.

spans.text: That's how it is with perspectives from long ago. These insular villages have never welcomed outsiders.

units.rawText: It would have been very difficult for Kimie to change their minds, no matter how hard she worked.
units.displayText: It would have been very difficult for Kimie to change their minds, no matter how hard she worked.

spans.text: It would have been very difficult for Kimie to change their minds, no matter how hard she worked.

units.rawText: You are right. I could not persuade the chief, and I could not relocate the villagers. But the only person I convinced was her...
units.displayText: You are right. I could not persuade the chief, and I could not relocate the villagers. But the only person I convinced was her...

spans.text: You are right. I could not persuade the chief, and I could not relocate the villagers. But the only person I convinced was her...

units.rawText: Will you really attempt to hold back the flood with your body?
units.displayText: Will you really attempt to hold back the flood with your body?

spans.text: Will you really attempt to hold back the flood with your body?

units.rawText: Kimie has no intention of questioning the traditions of your village, but with all due respect, this practice for which your permission was never sought, is cruel and inhumane.
units.displayText: Kimie has no intention of questioning the traditions of your village, but with all due respect, this practice for which your permission was never sought, is cruel and inhumane.

spans.text: Kimie has no intention of questioning the traditions of your village, but with all due respect, this practice for which your permission was never sought, is cruel and inhumane.

units.rawText: Kimie-sama... I was raised as a miko from a young age, and from that moment, I knew the day would come when I would be chosen as a human sacrifice.
units.displayText: Kimie-sama... I was raised as a miko from a young age, and from that moment, I knew the day would come when I would be chosen as a human sacrifice.

spans.text: Kimie-sama... I was raised as a miko from a young age, and from that moment, I knew the day would come when I would be chosen as a human sacrifice.

units.rawText: Our purpose is to convey the will of the kami and to relay the prayers of the people to the kami. If we have offended the kami, then we ought to placate them; if the kami punish the people, then we ought to take it for them.
units.displayText: Our purpose is to convey the will of the kami and to relay the prayers of the people to the kami. If we have offended the kami, then we ought to placate them; if the kami punish the people, then we ought to take it for them.

spans.text: Our purpose is to convey the will of the kami and to relay the prayers of the people to the kami. If we have offended the kami, then we ought to placate them; if the kami punish the people, then we ought to take it for them.

units.rawText: But are you not afraid? To slowly suffocate in the bone-chilling cold of the floodwater... Does it not frighten you?
units.displayText: But are you not afraid? To slowly suffocate in the bone-chilling cold of the floodwater... Does it not frighten you?

spans.text: But are you not afraid? To slowly suffocate in the bone-chilling cold of the floodwater... Does it not frighten you?

units.rawText: Our lives... are no longer our own...
units.displayText: Our lives... are no longer our own...

spans.text: Our lives... are no longer our own...

units.rawText: Everything from our births to our deaths... is for the sake of the kami... However... However...
units.displayText: Everything from our births to our deaths... is for the sake of the kami... However... However...

spans.text: Everything from our births to our deaths... is for the sake of the kami... However... However...

units.rawText: The sacrificial miko shudders despite herself. Kimie takes her hand and feels the cold in her palm.
units.displayText: The sacrificial miko shudders despite herself. Kimie takes her hand and feels the cold in her palm.

spans.text: The sacrificial miko shudders despite herself. Kimie takes her hand and feels the cold in her palm.

units.rawText: (Sobs) I know... I know I shouldn't be afraid... that from birth... I was meant to be an offering to the kami...
units.displayText: (Sobs) I know... I know I shouldn't be afraid... that from birth... I was meant to be an offering to the kami...

spans.text: (Sobs) I know... I know I shouldn't be afraid... that from birth... I was meant to be an offering to the kami...

units.rawText: Even though I know... that an ending like this... Even though... I was ready for this...
units.displayText: Even though I know... that an ending like this... Even though... I was ready for this...

spans.text: Even though I know... that an ending like this... Even though... I was ready for this...

units.rawText: Kimie... I don't know, I don't know why... my body is trembling... (sob)
